numbers_per_paragraph_S5_S6.lead: Raw readings are not evidence, ours or published, and calibrated ones are weak and model-dependent.
A published reading is reproduced and calibrated.
Most cells show structure beyond the second moments.
The count survives resampling.
No family owns the structure.
A star of clusters already passes the census.
Neural collapse is the flat limit, not what the census sees.
The alignment of each cluster with its hub is certified in four backbones.
No hierarchy above the superclasses is found in the supervised and contrastive backbones.
A deep hierarchy at the real noise level is detected.
The test never fires on randomized hubs.
The two-level implant is missed at ImageNet's noise level.
The certified set depends on the frame.
Leaf labels can produce the depth but do not guarantee it.
Imposing the geometry does not create detected depth.
The naive map manufactures an island.
Controlling the cut leaves a moderate gap.
The self-supervised tree is angular.
Alignment with WordNet follows supervision and recipe.
The recovery is not WordNet circularity.
Text depends on recipe, scale and probe.
Models share neighborhoods, not metrics.
The raw reading cannot select a curvature.
Both readings predict the gain, and the depth verdict predicts none.
The calibration certifies structure and does not choose the readout.
